# French cuisine — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What are the staple foods of French cuisine?", "butter, bread, wine, cheese"),
    ("Name a signature dish of French cuisine.", "Coq au vin"),
    ("What is region?", "France"),
    ("What is staples?", "butter, bread, wine, cheese"),
    ("What is signature dish 1?", "Coq au vin (chicken, red wine, mushrooms)"),
    ("What is signature dish 2?", "Bouillabaisse (fish, saffron, fennel)"),
    ("What is signature dish 3?", "Ratatouille (zucchini, eggplant, tomato)"),
    ("What is signature dish 4?", "Duck confit (duck leg, duck fat, garlic)"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
